Congratulations on completing this path! You practiced:

- Finding dashboards or data sources with natural language
- Generating queries with at-mentions
- Explaining an existing PromQL query
- Refining a query draft with a follow-up prompt
- Creating a draft dashboard or explaining an existing panel
